The UEBA system flagged Felix Dustin Fletcher's (User FDF2135) activity for review due to evidence from triggered rules. Specifically, there were 34 visits to job-search sites, which is an atypical behavior for his role as an Electrical Engineer in the Test and Evaluation team, far outside the peer distribution. Additionally, there was a significant increase in file operations, with 129 actions, exceeding the typical volume for this role by a wide margin.

While Felix's activity appears otherwise normal, with no unusual visits to leak-publication or cloud-storage sites, it is worth investigating further due to these two anomalous behaviors.
